name: s81sl_xrt1_b
structural_change: STW-S81-COLLA 10-21 s81sl_xrt1_b (FALLBACK): FFN result transport master ot_s81sl_xrt1 (TOK.DS.BENCH.4.2 safe redesign, ot_s81sl_xrt.sv on main, RG-FFN 59a8155d3: same ports as ot_s81sl_xr1, native census PASS max 32 / 0 drivers > 32 / rst_n 16) hardened from the CLOSED s81sl_xr1f kit geometry (pins, faces, recipe, io_flop_at_pins, reset landing unchanged); FOREG=1 (dedicated fault output flop, +1 fault-visibility cycle -- parent must build with +define+OT_S81SL_XR_FOREG if this view binds). | S81-SLICE (stream 0cm, owner-approved DV p4): new control-plane sub-leaf (centre leaf, C1 master, 14 per die) of the distributed-vector slice; flop-first pins, die hold budget; pin-bound square outline (7.8k pins, <= 6/um on full faces). XR2 (10-17, after EARLY_FAIL_SETUP -611 ps / 9.3k endpoints of 1dd564c6f): classify stage (+1 cycle on CTL / RD / lo / V / SC) registers the source select, CTL payload, RD row pairs and decoded per-target / per-leaf enables before any wide write (was one cycle E/N pin flop -> 1.1k-bit select -> 5x1024 unpacker enables); keep port registers for c_d / is_d / cfg_d / rb_d (synthesis had folded 960 + 160 pins onto 160 + 32 flops driving W and N faces); fixed-index pk pair writes. OWNERS-S81/XR (10-18): ported onto RTL-BUILD-S81's xr (ENG collector e_*/eg_* -> xfin s, g_* gate fan-out, CTL target 1 x_mode/x_scale; +738 pins -> 8.6k) -- outline 432 x 518.4 (W face c/sw/e/g 2,850 pins on 505 um = 5.6/um, S + x_mode/x_scale/eg). XR3 (OWNERS-S81/XR2 10-18, after --cts gate 6fe7b4ea6 pin-flop spread TT 113 / FF 103 and gate ba880f813 TT 135 / FF 120 with the late flops (+80..+135 ps, 451 of 16.2k) on the S-face pin band and the SW / SE corners): c_d / rb_* / g_* single copies fanned out in ot_s81sl_slice glue (-908 pins), clk / rst_n ranged at the E-face centre, outline 345.6 x 432, explicit CTS sink clustering (size 24 / 30 um, distance_between_buffers 15, balance_levels) so the edge pin-band leaves hang off short leaf nets. XR4 (S81-SLICEP 10-18, after gate2 2cf382261 sink clustering FAIL TT 128 / FF 113, insertion 866): 16 per-region clock roots by 2-D k-means (physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl, OT_CKKM_K 16: the pin-flop ring becomes 16 arcs / core masses of <= ~140 um, one BUFx24 local root at each centroid, CTS balances the roots), explicit cts_sink clustering dropped; io_hold_margin 0.025 (KITS rule 10-18). Same RTL, port, cycles, SDC. XR5 (S81-SAFE-FIX/XR1 10-19, SAFE-DESIGN CHECKLIST after the 1dd564c6f failed route; km16 gate c0a1bbe0c WARN spread 44/39, reg->reg +54.8): checklist item 3 -- every registered select that drove > ~32 data loads is now KEPT copies registered from the master's next state (rwe_c 160 ud word enables, rwr_c 40 + un_c 160 sw_d select / row-pair mux, pkw_c 32 pk pair writes, cis_c 35 ci_r select, tg1_c 2 x_eps/x_scale, lov_c 40 lo_v input-flop copies) and the x_s word select is a registered one-hot (eoh 15 / poh 5); +~490 flops, 0 data cycles. Kit: reset_landing 2 stages (rst_n port -> 2 landing flops -> ot_rst_relay; reset assert/release +2 cycles, a scheduled constant), io_hold_margin 0.03. | XR6 (S81-SAFE-FIX/XR1 10-19): 297c9bfab --cts gate TT -110.6 ps erun -> 20-term fault OR -> fault/ot_prs launch copy; fault terms registered per region (fa/fb/fc KEPT), sticky fault ORs 3 flops (+1 fault-visibility cycle, 0 data cycles). Parallel fallback kit s81sl_xr1f (FOREG=1). | XR1F-PIN (S81-SLICE3-XR1F 10-19, after the closed 12b616b54 native audit FAIL launch 286.1 > 220 on 42 pins, all x_eps / x_scale / x_mode; capture 127 / spread 67/64 PASS): the config outputs were enable-hold flops whose QN fed their own hold mux through NAND2 -> OA21, so io_flop_at_pins (ot_of_fbonly) did not anchor them. Now KEPT masters x_*_m hold the value and the pins leave DEDICATED KEPT output copies x_*_q (D = master next state, Q only the pin): +65 flops, 0 data cycles. Pin regions unchanged: x_s at the same 5.9 pins/um (plain DFF, anchored) launches 126-145 ps, so density is not the cause and every S-face group is already ~5.9/um (widening one would push another over 6/um).

job.purpose: S81 slice u_xr successor ot_s81sl_xrt1 (FB): replaces the old xr1/xr3 (functional gap: FFN result transport). Slice parents k8c-f (claude/s81-slicep-k8c-1021) instantiate ot_s81sl_xrt1.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81-SLICE): every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (ot_s81sl_xr header); recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage on every slice seam.

pin_reg_split_why: XR6 fallback (FOREG=1): fault leaves a dedicated output flop (fault <= fcore), no recirculation at the pin flop, so io_flop_at_pins anchors it; no pin_reg_split.
outline_why: STW-S81-COLLA 10-21 FALLBACK: s81sl_xr1f outline 311.04x395.28 enlarged to 345.6x432.0 (pin ranges scaled per face): lower pin density (<=~5.4/um) and wider std channels; no squeeze. | HOURLY-S81/XR1 10-19: 345.6x432 -> 311.04x395.28 (-18% area): pin-bound minimum at <=5.95 signal pins/um on every face (7651 pins: E 2214, W 2070, N 1708, S 1659; ranges re-spread uniformly per face, scalars 2.16 um, clk still E-face centre). Util stays ~7% (std ~8.1k um2): the 50-60% target is unreachable without cutting boundary bits (an architecture change of the slice seam, not a tile fix).
